FN-1P5CLLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 380
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Joe Lovvorn
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 380 as introduced could decrease potential income tax receipts to the Education
Trust Fund by a maximum of $2 million annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2029 by
extending the existing storm shelter income tax credit through tax year 2028.
